MAiSI is the Erasmus Mundus master in sports ethics and integrity coordinated through KU Leuven, preparing the next generation of integrity officers, safeguarding leads and anti-doping specialists. Applications for the 2027 intake opened on 8 October 2026, with the scholarship deadline on 1 February 2027 and later self-funded windows in April and July.

Programme Highlights

  • Only dedicated Erasmus Mundus programme in sports ethics and integrity
  • Mobility across consortium universities with specialisations in law, ethics and governance
  • Clear three-step timeline: scholarship round (1 February), non-EEA (1 April), EEA (1 July)
  • Graduates join federations, anti-doping agencies, betting-integrity units and universities

Who Should Apply

Applicants must already hold a completed bachelor's degree by the time of application, in law, ethics, sport science, sociology or a related area. KU Leuven's admissions procedure applies, including English-language evidence.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships cover participation costs and provide a monthly allowance; the consortium lists award numbers each year on its scholarship page.

Deadline and How to Apply

Start with the MAiSI programme guide, apply through KU Leuven's admissions office, and aim for the 1 February 2027 round if you need funding. Key deadline information: 1 February 2027 (Erasmus Mundus scholarship round; applications opened 8 October 2026). Non-EEA: 1 April 2027; EEA: 1 July 2027.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About MAiSI Consortium (KU Leuven)

The MAiSI consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master of Arts in Sports Ethics and Integrity, coordinated through KU Leuven with partner universities across Europe. Alumni work as integrity and safeguarding specialists across the Olympic and professional sport sectors.

Official website: https://www.maisi-project.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 1 February 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
